text:
ECA::select
Description
The ECA::select command is a replacement for NTLM::select
Syntax
ECA
::
select
select_ntlm:
<
ntlm-auth
configuration
name
>
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
HTTP
::
path
]
starts_with
"/protected_uri"
}
{
ECA
::
enable
ECA
::
select
select_ntlm:
/
Common
/
exch_ntlm_auth_config
}
else
{
ECA
::
disable
}
}
